//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

func TestPrivateFixtureWindowsRejectsUnprotectedOrBroadDACL(t *testing.T) {
	ordinary := t.TempDir()
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(ordinary); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("ordinary inherited directory accepted")
	}
	directory := filepath.Join(ordinary, "private-state")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(directory, "state")
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer file.Close()
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unprotected inherited state file accepted")
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	descriptor, err := windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("D:P(A;;FA;;;" + user.User.Sid.String() + ")(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FR;;;WD)")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	acl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := windows.SetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION, nil, nil, acl, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("Everyone-readable state file accepted")
	}
}

func privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t *testing.T, path string) string {
	t.Helper()
	descriptor, err := windows.GetNamedSecurityInfo(path, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	value := descriptor.String()
	if value == "" {
		t.Fatal("security descriptor could not be represented")
	}
	return value
}

func TestPrivateEvidenceWriterCreatesProtectedChildUnderInheritedParent(t *testing.T) {
	parent := t.TempDir()
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(parent); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("fixture parent must retain its ordinary inherited ACL")
	}
	parentSecurity := privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, parent)
	directory := filepath.Join(parent, "native-evidence")
	path := filepath.Join(directory, "mapping-startup.json")
	payload := []byte("{\"status\":\"failed\",\"observations\":[1,2,3]}\n")
	if err := writePrivateEvidence(directory, "mapping-startup.json", payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, payload) {
		t.Fatalf("private evidence roundtrip: %q, %v", got, err)
	}
	if got := privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, parent); got != parentSecurity {
		t.Fatal("writer changed its outer parent security descriptor")
	}
	directorySecurity, fileSecurity := privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, directory), privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, path)
	if err := writePrivateEvidence(directory, "mapping-startup.json", []byte("replacement")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("writer adopted an existing evidence child")
	}
	got, err = os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, payload) || privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, directory) != directorySecurity ||
		privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, path) != fileSecurity || privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, parent) != parentSecurity {
		t.Fatalf("existing private evidence changed after refusal: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPrivateEvidenceWriterPreservesExistingChildAndFile(t *testing.T) {
	for _, existingDirectory := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "existing file at child path"
		if existingDirectory {
			name = "existing ordinary directory and report"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			parent := t.TempDir()
			directory := filepath.Join(parent, "native-evidence")
			file := directory
			if existingDirectory {
				if err := os.Mkdir(directory, 0700); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				file = filepath.Join(directory, "mapping-startup.json")
			}
			payload := []byte("existing evidence must remain exact")
			if err := os.WriteFile(file, payload, 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			parentSecurity := privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, parent)
			childSecurity, fileSecurity := privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, directory), privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, file)
			if err := writePrivateEvidence(directory, "mapping-startup.json", []byte("replacement")); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("existing child was adopted")
			}
			got, err := os.ReadFile(file)
			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, payload) || privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, parent) != parentSecurity ||
				privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, directory) != childSecurity || privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, file) != fileSecurity {
				t.Fatalf("refusal changed existing bytes or ACL: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPrivateEvidenceWriterRejectsNonLeafBeforeCreation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"", ".", "..", "../report", `child\report`, "report:stream", "bad\x00name"} {
		parent := t.TempDir()
		security := privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, parent)
		directory := filepath.Join(parent, "native-evidence")
		if err := writePrivateEvidence(directory, name, []byte("payload")); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("non-leaf %q was accepted", name)
		}
		if _, err := os.Lstat(directory); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) || privateEvidenceTestSecurity(t, parent) != security {
			t.Fatalf("invalid name changed its parent or created a child: %v", err)
		}
	}
}

type privateEvidenceTestSink struct {
	calls    *[]string
	data     []byte
	written  int
	writeErr error
	syncErr  error
	closeErr error
	closed   bool
}

func (f *privateEvidenceTestSink) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	*f.calls = append(*f.calls, "write")
	if f.closed {
		return 0, os.ErrClosed
	}
	f.data = append([]byte(nil), data...)
	return f.written, f.writeErr
}

func (f *privateEvidenceTestSink) Sync() error {
	*f.calls = append(*f.calls, "sync")
	if f.closed {
		return os.ErrClosed
	}
	return f.syncErr
}

func (f *privateEvidenceTestSink) Close() error {
	*f.calls = append(*f.calls, "close")
	if f.closed {
		return os.ErrClosed
	}
	f.closed = true
	return f.closeErr
}

func TestPrivateEvidenceWriteSequenceRetainsAllErrors(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte("complete evidence\n")
	sealFailure, writeFailure := errors.New("seal failed"), errors.New("write failed")
	syncFailure, closeFailure := errors.New("sync failed"), errors.New("close failed")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name     string
		written  int
		sealErr  error
		writeErr error
		syncErr  error
		closeErr error
		closed   bool
		want     []error
	}{
		{name: "success", written: len(payload)},
		{name: "short write", written: len(payload) - 1, want: []error{io.ErrShortWrite}},
		{name: "write sync close errors", written: 2, writeErr: writeFailure, syncErr: syncFailure, closeErr: closeFailure, want: []error{writeFailure, syncFailure, closeFailure}},
		{name: "short write sync close errors", written: 2, syncErr: syncFailure, closeErr: closeFailure, want: []error{io.ErrShortWrite, syncFailure, closeFailure}},
		{name: "sync error", written: len(payload), syncErr: syncFailure, want: []error{syncFailure}},
		{name: "close error", written: len(payload), closeErr: closeFailure, want: []error{closeFailure}},
		{name: "closed file", closed: true, want: []error{os.ErrClosed}},
		{name: "seal and close errors", written: len(payload), sealErr: sealFailure, closeErr: closeFailure, want: []error{sealFailure, closeFailure}},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var calls []string
			file := &privateEvidenceTestSink{calls: &calls, written: test.written, writeErr: test.writeErr, syncErr: test.syncErr, closeErr: test.closeErr, closed: test.closed}
			err := writeSealedPrivateEvidence(file, payload, func() error {
				calls = append(calls, "seal")
				if len(file.data) != 0 {
					t.Fatal("payload reached the file before sealing")
				}
				return test.sealErr
			})
			if len(test.want) == 0 && err != nil || len(test.want) != 0 && err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("write result: %v", err)
			}
			for _, expected := range test.want {
				if !errors.Is(err, expected) {
					t.Fatalf("lost %v from %v", expected, err)
				}
			}
			wantCalls := []string{"seal", "write", "sync", "close"}
			if test.sealErr != nil {
				wantCalls = []string{"seal", "close"}
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(calls, wantCalls) || !file.closed {
				t.Fatalf("write ownership/order changed: %v", calls)
			}
			if test.sealErr == nil && !test.closed && !bytes.Equal(file.data, payload) {
				t.Fatal("writer changed the submitted payload")
			}
		})
	}
}
